verdict.rationale: Link CLI gives an agent access to a customer-controlled Link wallet. The agent can request one-time-use virtual cards or SPTs for purchases, and it can read balances and transactions from the bank and card accounts the customer chooses to share. The runtime probe confirms the CLI is published on npm. However, this is not a funded wallet the agent holds and spends from autonomously: every spend request needs the customer's approval, and balances shown are those of the underlying connected accounts, not a dedicated agent wallet balance. Missing for 10: a prefunded agent-held wallet balance, a standing spend allowance without per-transaction approval, independent hands-on corroboration.
